About

Harpagia Hub is a community-built collection of tools and a full game guide for Harpagia, written and maintained by Atlas and BienChien. The Minigame Helper was created by Adude, an old Harpagia player who helped us all get the zen charm.

How to use
1
Click any tool in the sidebar (topbar on mobile), or press any of the buttons below to load it in this panel.
2
Use the ↗︎ icon beside a tool name to open it in a new tab instead.
3
Run into any issues? Contact BienChien or Atlas on the Discord server.
Tools
This tool includes Zen, which uses screen capture and must run in its own tab to function. All credit to @a dude on discord for developing this tool!
